top_signals.title: Microsoft to start disclosing Azure quarterly revenue as company consolidates business units
top_signals.summary: Microsoft will begin reporting quarterly Azure revenue in dollars for the first time, providing more clarity about its business that competes with AWS.

top_signals.title: Nearly 1,000 business manager visa holders left Japan in first half of 2026
top_signals.summary: Under stricter requirements imposed since October, applicants must now have at least ¥30 million in capital, up from ¥5 million.
